generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms & conditions as per tender documents

technicalCriterionList.description: Work done certificate of satisfactory completion of one similar such work as prime contract (80% of the estimated value of contract (as per qualification of tenderer vide SL No.3-b) Rs-15.00 Lakhs)
GST, PAN, Latest I.T. Return, Last three months GSTR & other statutory registration certificates.

Least in 3 Financial years, a at least one year financial turnover not less than four times of the estimated value (as per qualification of tenderer vide SL No.3- a) (a minimum financial turnover of Rs.75.00 Lakhs)
Executed any one financial year ,the minimum Quantities of work.
Liquid assets and / or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs9.00 lakhs equivalent to the estimated cash flow for three months in the peak construction period
Whether tenderer is having Branch Office within 400km If Yes : address, contact person, E-mail ID to be furnished

Availability by owning at least 50% of the required /specified key and critical equipment for this work and the remaining 50% can be deployed on lease/hire basis for all works provide the relevant documents (commitment agreement etc.,)for availability for this works are furnished.
Tenderer should download the detailed technical specification provided by DMU, all the pages in the technical tender formats have been duly signed by authorized signatory.
Last 5 financial years Turnover duly signed by charted accountant uploaded

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair of floor of Day Storage Powder Godown at Product Dairy Dharwad.

itemList.description: Dismantling stone slab flooring laid in cement mortar including stacking of serviceable material and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.
Demolishing cement concrete manually/ by mechanical means including disposal of material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.

Providing and fixing coving tiles of size 300 mm 110 mm 50mm 12 mm thick at the junction/corners of walls and floors or wall-to-wall junctions, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge, using suitable approved adhesive or cement mortar, including cutting, shaping, and matching the edges at corners, maintaining proper alignment, level, and uniform curvature/profile, filling joints with suitable waterproof and chemical-resistant grout, cleaning the finished surface, and completing the work in all respects as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. The rate shall include the cost of materials, labour, tools and tackles, cutting, wastage, transportation, and all incidental charges necessary for completion of the work.

Providing and laying flooring using prepolished, water cut/gang saw 32mm thick granite laid over bed of 25mm thick 1:4 cm & jointed with neat cement slurry mixed with pigment to mach shade of granite slabs including laying POP on finished surface and cleaning the surface, including the cost of all materials and labours etc., complete as per specifications. - using silver grey granite / Multy Red / Ruby Red / Black / HassanGreen Granite of width not less than 900mm
